name: RescueTime
label: RescueTime Developers API
description: RescueTime Developers API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/rescuetime/api_spec.json). Official RescueTime Analytic Data API. Recommended auth is Authorization: Bearer (query param key= is still accepted by RescueTime but not used here — OfficialApiNode query auth would send api_key= which is not the documented param name). Personal productivity / PII — GDPR minimize; never log raw timelines. Official docs: https://help.rescuetime.com/article/464-getting-your-api-key. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One RescueTime official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"analytic_data"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'analytic_data', 'daily_summary', 'alerts_list', 'highlights_list'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'analytic_data'.

schema.label: perspective
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `perspective` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: resolution_time
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `resolution_time` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: restrict_begin
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `restrict_begin` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: restrict_end
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `restrict_end` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: restrict_kind
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `restrict_kind` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `format` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: Op
schema.description: alerts_list alerts_feed op. EXACT: status | list. Example: 'list'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: analytic_data, daily_summary, alerts_list, highlights_list. Default: analytic_data. Example: analytic_data.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey api_key). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Op
configurationParameters.description: alerts_list / alerts_feed mode. EXACT: status | list. Example: 'list'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
